items.title: Parker-Hannifin’s (NYSE:PH) Q3 CY2026: strong sales, stock soars
items.summary: Industrial machinery company Parker-Hannifin (NYSE:PH) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027) results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 17.9% year on year to $5.99 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $8.90 per share was 8.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
